title: Record page: a section whose fields are all empty folds like the others instead of showing dashes
body:
## Source

Walked on objectui main `8415d9f11`, the opportunity record `Demo Deal 01` at 1024 px: the Classification section shows two filled fields and "Show 4 empty fields"; the Sales Process section "Show 7 empty fields"; but "Deal Narrative" renders four rows "CUSTOMER BACKGROUND —, PROJECT BACKGROUND —, RISK ANALYSIS —, PAYMENT TERMS —" and "Notes & Next Steps" renders "DESCRIPTION —, NEXT STEP —": a section with no filled field prints every empty field as a dash instead of folding them. The lead record does the same for Address and Conversion.

## Target

1. A section whose fields are all empty renders its heading and one line "N empty fields" with the same "Show" affordance the mixed sections use; the dashes go.
2. When every section of a tab is empty, the tab shows one line for the whole tab.
3. Edit mode is unchanged: all fields are editable.

## File surface

`packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailView.tsx` (section rendering, the empty-field fold), tests beside.

## Acceptance

1. Tests: a section with all-empty fields renders the fold line and no "—"; a mixed section renders as today.
2. Screenshots of the opportunity record's Details tab at 1280 px.
3. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-detail test` green.

## Evidence

Screenshots on the temporary branch `claude/console-home-login-design-20261016` of objectstack-ai/objectui (commit `b72c97985`, never merged): [hotcrm-opportunity-record.jpg](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/b72c97985/docs/design/hotcrm-review-2026-10-16/hotcrm-opportunity-record.jpg?raw=true).

<sub>Filed by the epic PM session `session_cdb7a717-def7-4e71-9988-f089fbaa18ff` from the 2026-10-16 walk of HotCRM's core pages as a user: objectui main `8415d9f11`, HotCRM `63db83e2`, the vite console on :5180 against `objectstack serve --dev` on :4001, the maintainer's browser pane at 1024 × 768 (en). The maintainer asked for the findings to be filed on the repository each belongs to, verbatim: 「相关问题也在对应的项目上创建任务」.</sub>
